save.name: Ultimate Save (NO CC)
save.creator: PlumbobKingdom
save.knownIssue: Calendar holidays can make Sims miss work. Fix: open the calendar, filter to Holidays, choose Edit on each holiday, and delete any holiday whose edit screen will not open. You can recreate it afterward.

mods.name: MC Command Center
mods.creator: Deaderpool
mods.notes: Story progression, population and household control. Windows only. Install the core file plus only the modules you want.

mods.name: UI Cheats Extension
mods.creator: weerbesu
mods.notes: Edit needs, skills, relationships and traits from the UI. Free on weerbesu's Patreon; install both the .package and the .ts4script from the zip.

mods.name: XML Injector
mods.creator: Scumbumbo
mods.notes: Now maintained by Triplis. Needed by Seasonal Emotions and the Wildlife Biologist and Landlord careers. Remove version 1 when upgrading.

mods.name: Lumpinou's Toolbox
mods.creator: Lumpinou
mods.notes: Script library. Needed by First Impressions. Mods folder or one subfolder, no deeper.

mods.name: Mood Pack Mod
mods.creator: Lumpinou
mods.notes: Needed by First Impressions. The file is Lumpinou_MoodPackMod.package.

mods.name: WickedWhims
mods.creator: TURBODRIVER
mods.notes: Includes everything in Wonderful Whims, so skip that one. Delete old WickedWhims files before installing a new release.

mods.name: Basemental Drugs
mods.creator: Basemental
mods.notes: Includes the alcohol features, so you do not need a separate alcohol mod. Free from the site's Adult Mods menu. Redownload after every patch.

mods.name: Slice of Life
mods.creator: Kawaiistacie
mods.notes: Personality quirks, illness, injuries and deeper moods. Each feature downloads separately; put the script file directly in Mods. Creator corrected from Sacrificial on 2026-10-13 (Kawaiistacie's site and Patreon).

mods.name: Meaningful Stories
mods.creator: roBurky
mods.notes: Redesigns the mood and emotion system. Mood mods overlap, so add one at a time.

mods.name: First Impressions
mods.creator: Lumpinou
mods.notes: Shows trait-based first impressions in the relationship panel. Needs Lumpinou's Toolbox and Mood Pack Mod. Download only one version: WithTimeDecay or NoTimeDecay.

mods.name: Seasonal Emotions
mods.creator: Ellesimsworld
mods.notes: Needs XML Injector and Seasons.

mods.name: Connected Sims
mods.creator: A.deep.indigo
mods.notes: Adds more than 50 ways for friends and family to interact.

mods.name: Roommate Stories
mods.creator: Kawaiistacie
mods.notes: Roommates get careers, friends and activities of their own.

mods.name: Dine Out Reloaded (public version)
mods.creator: Carl's Guides
mods.notes: Only edit a restaurant while it is closed. Build the restaurant after installing, or chefs may stand outside. Can get blamed when another mod that touches work shifts is out of date.

mods.name: Restaurateur Aspiration
mods.creator: KiaraSims4Mods
mods.notes: Newbie to 5-star restaurant. The reward trait pays 1,000,000 simoleons.

mods.name: My Own Business Aspiration
mods.creator: Not listed
mods.notes: Aspiration that also covers retail and vet clinics.

mods.name: Pharmacist Career
mods.creator: midnitetech
mods.notes: Full 10-level career, base game. Adds an herbalism skill that suits a botanist. Delete the old version before updating.

mods.name: More Career Opportunities
mods.creator: KiaraSims4Mods
mods.notes: Adds a large set of new careers. No download page found under this name on 2026-10-13; check the creator's CurseForge list.

mods.name: midnitetech careers
mods.creator: midnitetech
mods.notes: Chiropractor, Librarian and other active or hybrid careers. Take the ones you want, one row each.

mods.name: Wildlife Biologist career
mods.creator: KiaraSims4Mods
mods.notes: Needs Island Living, Snowy Escape and XML Injector.

mods.name: Landlord career
mods.creator: KiaraSims4Mods
mods.notes: Needs For Rent and XML Injector.

mods.name: Unlimited Jobs
mods.creator: Not listed
mods.notes: Lets a Sim add a second freelance trade without dropping the first.

mods.name: Home Regions
mods.creator: Kuttoe
mods.notes: Keeps walkbys and townies to Sims who live in the local world and spreads townies across worlds. Base Game only. No build naming 1.128 was confirmed.

mods.name: Language Barriers
mods.creator: Frankk
mods.notes: Gives Sims six languages by home world. No 1.128 build confirmed, so check the site before installing.

mods.name: More Columns in CAS
mods.creator: weerbesu
mods.notes: Keeps a large CC collection browsable in Create a Sim. Free on weerbesu's Patreon; pick the 3, 4 or 5 column version (needs at least 1920x1080). Creator corrected from Simmattically on 2026-10-13.

mods.name: Sims 4 Tray Importer
mods.creator: Deevo
mods.notes: Imports and manages saved households and lots. A Windows app from LuniverSims, not a mod; keep it out of Mods.

lots.name: Live-in cafe
lots.description: Planned: cafe downstairs with one apartment upstairs, run as a Businesses & Hobbies small business by the household that lives there.
lots.notes: Name is a placeholder until the lot is placed and named in game. Switched from the Live in Business mod to the Businesses & Hobbies pack on 2026-10-12. Zone the apartment Residential so customers and staff stay out. Source: https://simscommunity.info/2025/03/22/the-sims-4-small-business-tutorial/

sessions.summary: Planning a live-in cafe with one attached apartment on a 30x20 lot in Nordhaven, using the Live in Business mod.
sessions.changes: Added world Nordhaven (Businesses & Hobbies) in place of the blank world row. Added lot Live-in cafe (Nordhaven, Residential, 30x20, planned) in place of the blank lot row. Then switched the lot to Residential (Small Business) for Businesses & Hobbies instead of the Live in Business mod.

sessions.summary: Simplify the install order: fewer batches, short test gates, optional mods made required, Wicked Perversions dropped, just what is needed to get each mod.
sessions.changes: Rebuilt index.html into Batches 0 to 4 with short notes, download links and two checks per batch. Removed Nisa's Wicked Perversions. Made Basemental Drugs, Roommate Stories, My Own Business Aspiration, Pharmacist Career and Unlimited Jobs required. Added Lumpinou's Toolbox and Mood Pack Mod (needed by First Impressions). Regrouped mod batches to match. Fixed creators: Slice of Life (Kawaiistacie), More Columns in CAS (weerbesu), Wildlife Biologist and Landlord careers (KiaraSims4Mods), Seasonal Emotions (Ellesimsworld), Tray Importer (Deevo). Added download links and pack requirements.

sessions.summary: Asked whether the folder-named scan rows should be in the tracker.
sessions.changes: Removed the six auto rows named after folders (Anim, Bazar, CAS, Gameplay, Foundation, KawaiiStacie), the same cleanup the page's next scan does. modsIgnore left empty so those folders are still scanned.

sessions.summary: Make each mod's name in the Mods folder section a link to a page for that mod with its website and installed vs newest known version.
sessions.changes: tracker.html: added a page per mod at tracker.html#mod/<id>, linked from the Mods and Mods folder tabs. It shows creator, website, installed version, version read from file names, newest known version and a version check, tested-on game version, last checked, files from the latest scan, scan keywords and related issues, and is editable when editing is on. tracker-data.json: added empty latestVersion and latestChecked to every mod.
